academic_translation:
Setting aside the next world,
When a servant does not do their work
And a master does not pay wages,
Even the purpose of this life will not be achieved.
translation: Leave the next life aside for a moment. If a servant does not do their work and a master pays no wages, nothing gets done. They will not even reach their goals in this life.

academic_translation:
Completely abandoning the perfect joy
That achieves seen and unseen happiness,
Through the cause of inflicting suffering on others,
One takes on unbearable suffering through delusion.
translation: Out of confusion, I might cause suffering to others. This only brings me unbearable suffering. I throw away the perfect joy that brings happiness I can see and cannot see.

academic_translation:
Whatever harm there is in the world, and
However much fear and suffering there may be,
If all of that arises from grasping at a self,
What use is that great demon to me?
translation: Think of all the harm, fear, and suffering in the world. If all of it comes from holding on to a self, what use is that great demon to me?

academic_translation:
If one does not completely let go of the very self,
One cannot abandon suffering,
Just as if one does not let go of fire,
One cannot avoid being burned.
translation: If I do not completely let go of the self, I cannot leave suffering behind. It is just like fire. If I do not let go of the fire, I cannot stop being burned.

academic_translation:
Therefore, to pacify harm to myself
And to pacify the suffering of others,
I should give myself to others
And hold others as myself.
translation: So, I want to stop harm to myself. I want to stop the suffering of others. To do this, I should give myself to others. I should treat others as myself.

academic_translation:
"I am under the power of others"—
O mind, you must know this with certainty.
Apart from the welfare of all sentient beings,
You should now think of nothing else.
translation: My mind, you must know this for sure. I am under the power of others. Now you must think only about what helps every living being. Do not think of anything else.

academic_translation:
With eyes and so forth that are under the power of others,
It is not appropriate to accomplish one's own welfare.
With eyes and so forth that are for their sake,
It is not appropriate to act wrongly toward them.
translation: My eyes and other parts belong to others. It is wrong to use them for my own good. They are for the sake of others. It is wrong to use them to harm others.

academic_translation:
Therefore, make sentient beings foremost.
Whatever you see upon my body,
Having snatched it away,
Act for the benefit of others.
translation: Therefore, put every living being first. Look at whatever is on my body. Take it away, and use it to help others.

academic_translation:
Having made the inferior and so forth into oneself,
And having made oneself into others,
With a mind free of conceptual thought,
Meditate on envy, rivalry, and pride.
translation: Pretend that you are someone lower. Pretend that others are you. Clear your mind of busy thinking. Then practice feeling jealousy, rivalry, and pride.
People honor that person, but not me. I did not get what they got. That person is praised, but people say bad things about me. They are happy, but I am in suffering.

academic_translation:
I perform the labors, and
This one remains in happiness itself.
This one is great in the world, and
I am known as inferior and without good qualities.
translation: I do all the hard work, while this person just stays in happiness. This person is great in the world, but people say I am low and without good qualities.

academic_translation:
What is the use of being without good qualities?
All of us are indeed endowed with good qualities.
There are those compared to whom this one is inferior, and
there are those compared to whom I am superior.
translation: What is the use of having no good qualities? Everyone has good qualities. There are people who are better than this person. There are also people who I am better than.

academic_translation:
The decline of ethical discipline, view, and so forth
is due to the power of afflictions; it is not under my control.
I must be healed as much as possible,
and I will accept even harm.
translation: Losing my good conduct, my belief, and other things is caused by strong troubling emotions. It is out of my control. I must be healed as much as possible, and I will even accept harm.

academic_translation:
However, if I am not to be healed by this one,
why does he despise me?
What use are his good qualities to me?
This one himself possesses good qualities!
translation: But if this person will not heal me, why does he look down on me? What use are his good qualities to me? He is the one who has those good qualities!

academic_translation:
Dwelling in the jaws of vicious lower realms,
this one lacks compassion for wandering beings.
Moreover, conceited about his good qualities,
he wishes to challenge wise persons.
translation: Standing in the jaws of cruel unhappy realms, this person has no compassion for beings. He is proud of his good qualities. He even wants to challenge wise persons.

academic_translation:
Looking at one equal to me,
in order to make myself superior,
my gain and honor
I shall certainly secure, even through dispute.
translation: When I look at someone equal to me, I want to make myself better than them. I will certainly get my gain and respect, even if I have to argue.

academic_translation:
I shall ensure that my good qualities
Are made clear to the entire world,
And furthermore, whatever good qualities this one has,
I shall ensure that no one hears of them.
translation: I will make sure my good qualities are clear to the whole world. And whatever good qualities this person has, I will make sure no one hears about them.

academic_translation:
I shall also conceal my faults,
I shall be venerated, but not this one.
Today I shall acquire excellent gains,
I shall be respected, but not this one.
translation: I will also hide my faults. I will be honored, but not this person. Today I will get great things. I will be respected, but not this person.

academic_translation:
When this one is brought to ruin,
I shall look on with joy for a long time.
I shall make him the laughingstock of all wandering beings,
And the object of their mutual derision.
translation: When this person is ruined, I will gladly watch for a long time. I will make all beings laugh at them. I will make everyone make fun of them.

academic_translation:
It is said that even this miserable one
Is competing together with me.
But is this one equal in learning or wisdom,
Or in form, family, or wealth?
translation: People say that even this miserable person is competing with me. But is this person equal to me in learning or wisdom? Are they equal in looks, family, or wealth?

academic_translation:
Having heard of my good qualities
Proclaimed to everyone in this way,
I shall fully enjoy the happiness
Of the thrilling joy that arises.
translation: Hearing my good qualities announced to everyone like this, I will feel a thrilling joy. I will fully enjoy this happiness.

academic_translation:
Even if this one acquires some gain,
If he does my work,
I shall give him just enough to live on,
And I shall take it by my power.
translation: Even if this person gets something, if they do my work, I will give them just enough to live on. I will take what they got using my power.

academic_translation:
This one shall be made to fall from happiness,
And be constantly subjected to my harm;
For by this one, across all hundreds of lifetimes,
Harm was done to me in saṃsāra.
translation: I will make this one lose his happiness. I will harm him all the time. He has hurt me for hundreds of lifetimes in the cycle of rebirth.

academic_translation:
O mind, because you wished to accomplish your own welfare,
Even though countless eons have passed,
Through such great weariness
You have accomplished only suffering.
translation: O mind, you only wanted your own good. Countless great ages have passed. You worked until you were very tired, but you only got suffering.

academic_translation:
Thus, you must certainly apply yourself
Thoroughly to the welfare of others;
Because the word of the Sage is infallible,
You will later see its good qualities.
translation: You must truly work hard to help others. The words of the Sage are never wrong. Later you will see the good qualities of doing this.

academic_translation:
If, in former times,
you had performed this action,
what is not the perfect happiness of a Buddha—
such a situation as this could not possibly occur.
translation: If you had helped others in the past, you would not be stuck like this. You would surely have the perfect happiness of a Buddha.

academic_translation:
Therefore, just as upon drops
Of the semen and blood of others
You have engaged in grasping as "I",
Likewise habituate yourself toward others too.
translation: You are used to taking as "I" the drops of seed and blood from others. In the same way, get used to doing this for everyone else.

academic_translation:
Having acted as a spy for others,
Whatever appears upon my body,
Having snatched those very things away,
You must practice what is beneficial for others.
translation: Act like a spy for other people. Watch whatever appears on my body. Snatch those things away, and practice what is good for others.

academic_translation:
"I am happy and others are unhappy,
I am high and others are low,
I do what is beneficial and others do not"—
Why do you not feel envy toward yourself?
translation: "I am happy and others are unhappy. I am high and others are low. I do good things and others do not." Why do you not feel jealousy toward yourself?

academic_translation:
Separate yourself from happiness,
And apply the suffering of others to yourself.
Asking, "What is this one doing at any time?"
Examine your own faults.
translation: Give up your own happiness. Take the suffering of others onto yourself. Always ask, "What is this self doing right now?" Look closely at your own faults.

academic_translation:
Even when a fault is committed by others,
Transform it into your own fault;
And even if a fault committed by yourself is small,
Confess it fully to many people.
translation: If others make a mistake, treat it as your own fault. But if you make even a small mistake, confess it to many people.

academic_translation:
By speaking highly of the reputation of others,
Suppress your own reputation.
Like the lowest of servants,
Employ yourself for all purposes.
translation: Praise other people so much that you hide your own fame. Act like the lowest servant. Put yourself to work for everyone else.

academic_translation:
This one is of a faulty nature,
Do not praise it for a fraction of an adventitious good quality.
Regarding its good qualities, by all means,
Act so that no one at all will know them.
translation: This self is full of faults. Do not praise it just for having a tiny, temporary good quality. Make sure that no one at all knows about your good qualities.

academic_translation:
In short, for your own sake,
Whatever harm you have done to others,
For the sake of sentient beings,
Let that harm descend upon yourself.
translation: In short, think of any harm you have ever done to others for your own sake. Now, for the sake of all living beings, let that harm fall upon yourself.

academic_translation:
Lest it become overbearing,
Do not foster its strength;
Just like a new bride,
Keep it restrained with shame and fear.
translation: Do not let it grow strong, or it will become bossy. Keep it held back with shame and fear, just like a new bride.

academic_translation:
"Do that! Remain like that!
You must not act in that way!"
In this manner, bring this under control;
If it transgresses that, it must be subdued.
translation: Tell it, 'Do this! Stay like that! Do not act that way!' Bring it under control like this. If it breaks the rules, you must stop it.

academic_translation:
Yet, even when instructed in that way,
if you, my mind, do not act like that,
since all faults rely upon you,
there is nothing left but to subdue you yourself.
translation: Even when I tell you what to do, if you do not listen, my mind, I must defeat you. All faults come from you, so I have no other choice.

academic_translation:
That former time when you ruined me
Was another time;
Now I see you—where will you go?
I shall destroy all your haughtiness.
translation: That past time when you ruined me is over. Now I see you. Where will you go? I will destroy all your feeling superior.

academic_translation:
"I still have my own welfare"—
Discard that thought!
Since I have sold you to others,
Do not be discouraged, offer your service.
translation: Throw away the thought, 'I still have my own good!' I have sold you to others. Do not be sad. Just give them your help.

academic_translation:
If, falling into heedlessness,
I do not give you to sentient beings,
You will certainly hand me over
To the guardians of hell.
translation: If I fall into carelessness and do not give you to living beings, you will surely hand me over to the guards of hell.
